verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly list integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, and Linear, and describe agents that run on triggers/schedules and collaborate in Slack or review PRs in GitHub, supporting the story's core claim. However, there's no detailed first-party documentation of the exact trigger mechanics per platform (e.g., a Linear ticket auto-spawning an agent) nor independent/hands-on confirmation that this works reliably. Missing for 10: platform-specific trigger documentation for each of GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack, and independent verification of the workflow in practice.
